name: Isocarboxazid
summary: Isocarboxazid, sold under the brand name Marplan among others, is a non-selective irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class. Along with phenelzine and tranylcypromine, it is one of the three classic irreversible, non-selective MAOIs used as antidepressants in modern psychiatric practice.

pharmacology.text: Isocarboxazid, like other classic non-selective irreversible MAOIs, inhibits both monoamine oxidase A and monoamine oxidase B, reducing the breakdown of the monoamine neurotransmitters serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine.

uses.text: Isocarboxazid, sold under the brand name Marplan among others, is a non-selective irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class. Along with phenelzine and tranylcypromine, it is one of the three classic irreversible, non-selective MAOIs used as antidepressants in modern psychiatric practice. Isocarboxazid is used primarily in treatment-resistant depression.

sideEffects.text: It may also be considered as an alternative classic MAOI when phenelzine or tranylcypromine is not well tolerated, including when troublesome daytime somnolence, sedation, sleep disturbance, or other adverse effects limit treatment.
